note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.sel.liner module functions. 3DEC 7.0-only module: the legacy SEL (structural element) scripting interface. Absent from 3DEC 9.x, where structural elements are accessed through itasca.structure instead. All signatures and descriptions were captured from live 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161) __doc__ introspection.

methods.name: area
methods.description: Get the area of the liner.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the liner extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: face
methods.description: Get the attached face.

methods.name: fiber_max
methods.description: Get the maximum outer fiber stress.

methods.name: fiber_min
methods.description: Get the minimum outer fiber stress.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the liner group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: liner.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the liner. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this liner is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the liner id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: liner.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the liner is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Get the index (offset) of the liner element.

methods.name: matnum
methods.description: Get the material number assigned to a liner.

methods.name: membrane_max
methods.description: Get the maximum membrane stress.

methods.name: membrane_min
methods.description: Get the minimum membrane stress.

methods.name: moment
methods.description: Get the liner liner moment (vector).

methods.name: moment_max
methods.description: Get the maximum bending moment.

methods.name: moment_min
methods.description: Get the minimum bending moment.

methods.name: moment_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the liner liner moment.

methods.name: moment_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the liner liner moment.

methods.name: moment_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the liner liner moment.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Get the a node of a liner face (input {0, 1, 2} for the first, second, or third node of the face, respectively).

methods.name: normal
methods.description: Get the liner liner normal (vector).

methods.name: normal_stiffness
methods.description: Get the normal stiffness (force/displacement) of the interface between the liner element and the rock/soil.

methods.name: normal_strength
methods.description: Get the normal (tensile) strength of the interface between the liner element and the rock/soil.

methods.name: normal_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the liner liner normal.

methods.name: normal_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the liner liner normal.

methods.name: normal_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the liner liner normal.

methods.name: poiss
methods.description: Get Poisson's ratio.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the liner liner position (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the liner liner position.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the liner liner position.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the liner liner position.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the liner extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: liner.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the liner group name in a given slot.

methods.name: shear_cohesion
methods.description: Get the cohesion at the interface of the liner element and the rock/soil.

methods.name: shear_friction
methods.description: Get the friction angle (in degrees) of the interface of the liner element and the soil/rock.

methods.name: shear_stiffness
methods.description: Get the shear stiffness (Force / displacement) at the interface between the liner element and the rock/soil.

methods.name: stress
methods.description: Get the liner liner stress (vector).

methods.name: stress_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the liner liner stress.

methods.name: stress_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the liner liner stress.

methods.name: stress_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the liner liner stress.

methods.name: thermalexp
methods.description: Get thermal expansion coefficient.

methods.name: thickness
methods.description: Get liner thickness.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this liner is live.

methods.name: young
methods.description: Get Young's modulus.
